title: 第十章 合情合理【收藏推荐月票】
novel_title: 方彻刚刚更新内容(长夜君主)
content_zh: “那苏家的苏越……”方浅意再次提起这件事。而方彻也立即显示出了前身以往的态度，很是坚决而且带着一点不耐烦，道：“娘，这您就别管了，苏越是我的好兄弟，好大哥，难道您还不允许我有几个好朋友吗？”“好朋友？这个苏越分明别有用心……”“我不听我不听……”方彻摇头若拨浪鼓。方浅意深深叹气。只感觉自己儿子，依然是之前那个傻小子，而且还听不懂道理。只能自己以后替他好好看着了。“真愁人。”……第二天一早。方彻在练功。方正航已经亲自去了守护者大殿，交这个月的方家贡献值任务，以及，报备外甥私自拜师的事情。而方浅意……方浅意是被自己臭醒的。昨晚吃完饭，她洗洗澡就睡了，总感觉身上黏糊糊，搓了好几遍；但这段时间漂泊在外，实在是太疲乏，回到自己家又是无比安心，上床后没多久就睡了过去。结果早晨一睁眼，发现自己闺房直接成了厕所一样。自己整个人都被糊在了一层臭烘烘污泥之中。“天哪……”……赶紧让侍女服侍洗了一下，换好衣服出来的时候，只听见房后有侍女的‘呕呕’的声音……忍不住脸上一红。窘迫还未过去，就感觉自己身体有了天翻地覆的变化。更轻灵，头脑更灵活，对天地灵气的敏感度，居然增加了数倍。当然，最主要的是，照照镜子，皮肤比起之前，竟然好了不少。白里透红，娇嫩紧致，甚至比自己十七八岁大姑娘的时候，状态还要好。“哎呀呀……”方浅意刹那间神采飞扬。出来看到方彻，忍不住提着裙子转了一圈：“彻儿，你看我今天有啥变化？”“？？？”方彻眨眨眼，有些懵逼，但只是稍微转了转脑子，就立即开始大力夸赞：“娘，你这一晚上返老还童了啊！”“哈哈哈……”方浅意得意至极，心情舒畅，哈哈大笑。笑了一会突然问道：“返老还童？我之前很老吗？”方彻一脸发自内心：“娘，绝对没有，只是锦上添花，一天比一天年轻。”方浅意满意点头，从怀里取出来一面小镜子，照了照，美滋滋道：“这话说得中肯。”“那是。我这段时间一直在发愁。”“愁什么？”“愁着找媳妇的事儿，我娘这么美，我找媳妇总不能找個太难看的，给咱家丢了人，但问题是，按照娘您的一半标准来找，可也是不好找啊。”“鹅鹅鹅……”方浅意发出了奇怪的笑声。随即一脸高兴放松，道：“你这些年笨头笨脑的，话也不会说，一点也不像你爹，我纳闷好久了，怎么生个儿不随爹？”她快乐的舒口气，道：“今天我终于放心了！你这睁眼说瞎话哄姑娘的水平，颇有你爹三分神韵了。”方彻：“……”我爹那是有多渣啊？然后方浅意兴冲冲的出门而去。家族在商量事，她也没参加，那都不重要。现在最重要的是找几个闺蜜聚聚。……苏家的主事人全部失踪了。这个消息，终于还是被确定了。在等了这几天之后，方家开始行动：这么多年的老对手没落了，如何能分一杯羹？大家各抒己见，都很兴奋。甚至，方吕张魏四家也都在相互拜访，秘密串联。……小院。孙元已经想走了。因为徒弟的一些问题，他已经回答不了了。徒弟练功的毛病，他也基本挑不出来了。一身本事，甚至连易容术骗术赌术都被掏的干干净净！“就没见过这么当徒弟的，也没见过我这种当师父的！”孙元很惆怅。“徒儿你好好练功，准备大比考入武院。现在苏家那边出了事，我要过去看看。”孙元道。“啊？我苏大哥家出了事？”方彻立即紧张起来：“我大哥出了什么事？”孙元对于苏越引导方彻，利用方彻的事情那是清清楚楚的，甚至五灵蛊还是他给苏越下给方彻的，自然知道苏越的嘴脸。看到方彻现在居然还是这么情深意重，忍不住心里就翻个白眼。在那之前，孙元的立场自然是站在苏家那边的，毕竟那是教内发展的家族，属于自己一方的。
content_en: "Then Su Yue from the Su family..." Fang Qianyi mentioned this matter again.And Fang Che immediately showed his predecessor's previous attitude, very resolute and a little impatient, and said: "Mom, don't worry about this. Su Yue is my good brother and big brother. Don't you still allow me to have a few good friends?" "Good friends? This Su Yue clearly has ulterior motives..." "I won't listen, I won't listen..." Fang Che shook his head like a rattle.Fang Qianyi sighed deeply.I just feel that my son is still the stupid boy before, and he still doesn't understand the truth.I can only watch over him carefully from now on."It's so sad."...Early the next morning.Fang Che is practicing.Fang Zhenghang has already gone to the Guardian Hall in person to hand over the Fang family's contribution value task for this month, and to report his nephew's private apprenticeship.And Fang Qianyi... Fang Qianyi woke up because of his own stink.After eating last night, she took a shower and went to bed. She always felt sticky and rubbed herself several times. However, she was really tired from wandering around during this period, and she felt extremely relieved when she returned home. She fell asleep not long after going to bed.As a result, when I opened my eyes in the morning, I found that my boudoir had become a toilet.His whole body was covered in a layer of smelly sludge."Oh my god..."... He quickly asked the maid to wash him. When he changed his clothes and came out, he only heard the sound of "vomiting" from the maid behind the room... He couldn't help but blush on his face.Before the embarrassment had passed, I felt that my body had undergone earth-shaking changes.He is lighter and more agile, his mind is more flexible, and his sensitivity to the aura of heaven and earth has actually increased several times.Of course, the most important thing is that when I look in the mirror, my skin is much better than before.Fair and rosy, tender and firm, even better than when she was a girl of seventeen or eighteen."Oops..." Fang Qianyi suddenly became full of energy.When he came out and saw Fang Che, he couldn't help but hold up his skirt and spin it around: "Cheer, do you think I have changed today?" "???" Fang Che blinked, a little confused, but just turned his head a little, and immediately began to praise: "Mom, you have rejuvenated this night!" "Hahaha..." Fang Qianyi was extremely proud, in a good mood, and laughed.After laughing for a while, he suddenly asked: "Rejuvenated? Was I very old before?" Fang Che said with a heartfelt expression: "Mom, absolutely not, it's just the icing on the cake, getting younger day by day." Fang Qianyi nodded with satisfaction, took out a small mirror from her arms, looked at it, and said happily: "That's right." "That's right. II've been worried about it for a while."I'm worried about finding a wife. My mother is so beautiful. I can't find a wife who is too ugly and will embarrass our family. But the problem is that it's not easy to find one based on half of your standards.""Goose goose..." Fang Qianyi laughed strangely.Then she looked happy and relaxed, and said: "You have been clumsy these years and can't speak. You are nothing like your father. I have been wondering for a long time, why would you not follow your father when you gave birth to a child?" She sighed happily and said: "I am finally relieved today! Your ability to tell lies and coax girls with your eyes open is quite as charming as your father." Fang Che: "..." How scumbag is my father?Then Fang Qianyi went out happily.The family was discussing matters and she didn't participate, so that didn't matter.The most important thing now is to get together with some best friends....All the principals of the Su family have disappeared.The news was finally confirmed.After waiting for a few days, the Fang family took action: their old rival for so many years has declined, how can they get a piece of the pie?Everyone expressed their opinions and were very excited.Even the four families of Fang, Lu, Zhang and Wei were visiting each other and keeping in touch secretly....small courtyard.Sun Yuan already wanted to leave.Because he could no longer answer some of the disciple's questions.He could hardly find fault with his apprentice's practice.With all his skills, even the art of disguise, cheating, and gambling have been completely exploited!"I've never seen anyone be a disciple like this, and I've never seen someone like me be a master!" Sun Yuan was very melancholy."Disciple, you should practice hard and prepare for the competition to enter the martial arts academy. Now there is something going on with the Su family, and I want to go over and take a look." Sun Yuandao."Ah? Something happened to my brother Su's family?" Fang Che immediately became nervous: "What happened to my brother?" Sun Yuan was very clear about Su Yue's guidance and use of Fang Che. He even gave Su Yue the Five Spirit Gu to Fang Che, so he naturally knew Su Yue's face.Seeing that Fang Che was still so affectionate now, I couldn't help but roll my eyes in my heart.Before that, Sun Yuan's position was naturally on the side of the Su family. After all, it was a family that developed within the church and belonged to his own side.
